facts.fact: Ivoirexpress reports SNDI, a state company, develops and deploys business applications for the Ivorian government and operates a national satellite network used by government bodies.
Ivoirexpress reports SNDI developed version 1 of SIGOMAP, which recently replaced SIGMAP for public procurement by ministries.

Ivoirexpress reports SNDI built SIGFIP, SIGMAP and SIGOMAP, the CEPICI one-stop shop system, the building-permit one-stop system, and the government roadmap and decision tracking platforms, naming no contractor.
